caption: This drawing features a symmetrical composition with a large central stylized flower in red, yellow, and brown tones. Branches with greenish-blue leaves and red circular fruits extend outward from the base and sides of the flower. Perched among the branches are six birds, each predominantly colored in shades of red, yellow, and green, displaying patterned wings and tails. Three birds are placed on each side, with one on top, one in the middle, and one at the bottom, forming a mirror image across the central axis. Beneath the main flower and birds, there is a heart shape outlined with small decorative lines containing text written in German. Additional lines of text are present below the heart across the lower part of the image. The background is a muted beige, and the drawing is enclosed within a roughly rectangular border, with some minor discoloration and wrinkling present throughout the paper.
title: Fractur Drawing  (Birth Certificate)
